LEVEL 3, THE KILN (NIGHT29, builder R, DESIGN29.md section E; GG: 'a ring route', 'there always really needs to be a route that enemies can climb up', 'most weapons should zoom'). The THUNDERCLAP (the shotgun) is picked up in k1 (a pickup in view on entry, the `pickup` row; the room's `award` is the fallback). k1 the loading bay (a ring route round a central press, a cluster of 8 husks the pellets clear, then 4 swarmers), k2 the casting floor (a pit crossed by a 2 m bridge, two spitters on a far shelf the shotgun cannot reach: the pistol's charge shot answers), k3 rest, k4 the flue (a hazard floor under a tall shaft: a wall lane along the west wall and a gantry up the east wall (the card had two: a wedge ramp starts at y 0 and a 0.5 m step is a jump link, so the second gantry is not built), 8 husks and a heavy), k5 THE RING (the worm's room: a boss room; the arena is the existing worm map, builder B / the lead). Walkers climb wedge ramps only (the nav grid links a 0.5 m step as a jump, which walkers do not take). Pars: k1 and k2 are the bot's medians over 10 seeds, the rest are estimates (see Tools/night/n29-pars.json). Generated by Tools/night/gen-n30-kiln.cjs through n29-lib.cjs. Web coordinates, metres: x east, y up, z SOUTH.
